skills.name: daily-briefing
skills.description: Daily briefing on today's developments in technology, digitalisation, data and AI, filtered against this vault and rendered as an interactive HTML dashboard. Triggers include daily briefing, briefing, brief mich, was gibt es Neues, news update, tech news, was ist heute passiert.

skills.name: humanizer
skills.description: Humanize a text and remove the signs of AI-generated writing, from inflated symbolism and AI vocabulary to em dash overuse, rule of three, passive voice, negative parallelisms and filler phrases. Triggers include humanize this, Text prüfen, AI-Sprachmuster entfernen.

skills.name: ingest
skills.description: One source in, one note out, no dialog. A PDF, Office file, web clip or markdown becomes an OKF note in under two minutes. Triggers include ingest this, schnell ingesten, nimm das auf, ab in die Inbox, quick ingest, webclip aufnehmen. For dialog and block links use ingest-deep.

skills.name: ingest-deep
skills.description: Deep ingest of one source in a multi-turn dialog, with block-level links back into it. A PDF, Office file, web clip or YouTube video becomes a sense-making note or several zettel. Triggers include ingest deep, deep dive a source, tiefer Ingest, YouTube-Video ingesten. One fast note is ingest.

skills.name: interview-insights
skills.description: Turns product interviews into a citable OKF interview note and, across several named notes, a weighted Insight Report plus an offline HTML Insight Board. Triggers include Interview auswerten, Insight Report, interview synthesis, Insight Board, Interviews zusammenführen.

skills.name: knowledge-link
skills.description: Wire a note that already exists into the knowledge graph, with properties, wikilinks and MOC entries proposed before anything is written. Triggers include verdrahte diese Notiz, Notiz einordnen, verknüpfe die Notiz, link this note, connect it to the graph. A source file goes to ingest first.

skills.name: meeting-summary
skills.description: Compact summary of a transcript note that stays digestible in under a minute. Strictly on the transcript, no interpretations. Sets block-IDs at key passages and links each statement in the summary discreetly via ↗ symbol to the source passage. Single-note layout (summary on top, transcript below).

skills.name: note-creator
skills.description: Creates a new Obsidian note with humanized, directly citable text, in German or English. Use whenever the user asks to create, write or draft a note, a document, a summary or any other vault content.

skills.name: plaud-import
skills.description: Holt neue Plaud-Aufnahmen als rohe Meeting-Notizen in den Vault. Trigger sind hol neue Plaud-Transkripte, Plaud-Aufnahmen in den Vault, welche Plaud-Notes fehlen, sync Plaud. Nur der Ingest, die Deutung mit TL;DR, Zusammenfassung und Sprechernamen macht danach meeting-summary.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create, improve or debug a Vault Operator skill. Also right when a task costs time every week, or the user wants a recurring deliverable but cannot name the solution. Triggers include create a skill, neuer Skill, make this repeatable, kannst du das automatisieren, der Skill macht X falsch.

skills.name: weekly-meeting-summary
skills.description: Condenses the current week's meeting notes into one digest with decisions, open points and next steps. Triggers include weekly summary, Wochenzusammenfassung Meetings, summarise my meetings, fasse meine Meetings zusammen, was war diese Woche in meinen Meetings.
